{#- Set the document direction to RTL for right-to-left languages (Arabic, Hebrew). The Shibuya theme renders without a dir attribute, so we add it here. Done with a tiny head script -- which runs before first paint, the same pattern the theme uses for its color-mode script -- so there is no flash of left-to-right layout. rtl.css (loaded for every build, scoped to [dir="rtl"]) mirrors the chrome once this attribute is set. text_direction is provided by conf.py's html-page-context hook. STATUS: parked / future work. RTL is currently DISABLED (RTL_ENABLED = False in conf.py), so text_direction is always "ltr" and this script never runs. -#} {%- if text_direction == "rtl" -%} {%- endif -%}
